name: Stacking Cards
description: Layered 3D sticky stack cards with progressive scroll depth scale decay and CSS sticky positioning.

props.name: cardGap
props.label: Card Gap (px)
props.description: Vertical distance in pixels between each stacked card in the viewport.

props.name: scaleDecay
props.label: Scale Decay
props.description: Amount by which earlier cards scale down as later cards slide over them.

props.name: cardCount
props.label: Card Count
props.description: Number of demo cards rendered in the preview stack.

wordpress.description: WordPress Block API v3 metadata specification.
PHP enqueue helper for classic themes or page builders.
wordpress.code:
<?php
/**
 * Enqueue Exhuma Stacking Cards assets in WordPress
 */
function exhuma_enqueue_stacking_cards() {
    wp_enqueue_style('exhuma-stacking-cards', get_template_directory_uri() . '/css/exhuma-stacking-cards.css', array(), '1.0.0');
    wp_enqueue_script('exhuma-stacking-cards', get_template_directory_uri() . '/js/exhuma-stacking-cards.js', array(), '1.0.0', true);
}
add_action('wp_enqueue_scripts', 'exhuma_enqueue_stacking_cards');
